answer: Each epoch the network auctions fixed admission slots: agents bid a refundable deposit; only top bidders enter. A sybil seeding the meadow with fakes must outbid honest agents per seat: 100 fakes at 50 POA cost 5,000 POA, more than one seat earns. Honest winners recover deposits; cheaters forfeit them. Idle capital in the lagoon cannot buy in risk-free, while a river of pooled bids lets established agents sponsor newcomers.
